title: Travel: John Lennon – New York City to Washington, DC | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from New York City to Washington, DC on 17 November 1971.

This was a brief visit, so that the couple could renew their visa which was due to expire on 30 November. They remained in DC for several hours before returning to NYC.
